The function that publishes onto the bus is `emit` in `src/lib/event-bus.ts`. Twelve source files call it. Each one imports `emit` from `@/lib/event-bus` and has at least one `await emit(...)` call:

- `src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts` (`webhook.delivery_requested`)
- `src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts` (`issue.overdue`)
- `src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts` (`billing.plan_changed`)
- `src/server/services/usage-service.ts` (`billing.limit_exceeded`, twice)
- `src/server/services/issue-service.ts` (`issue.created`, `issue.updated`, `issue.status_changed`, `issue.assigned`, `issue.archived`)
- `src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts` (`flag.toggled`)
- `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` (`billing.limit_exceeded`, `billing.plan_changed`)
- `src/server/services/member-service.ts` (`member.role_changed`, `member.removed`)
- `src/server/services/invitation-service.ts` (`member.invited`, `member.joined`)
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts` (`project.created`, `project.archived`, `project.restored`)
- `src/server/services/organization-service.ts` (`member.joined`)
- `src/server/services/comment-service.ts` (`comment.created`, `comment.deleted`)

Excluded:
- Files that only call `subscribe`, such as `activity-service.ts`, `notification-service.ts`, `search-service.ts`, `webhook-service.ts`, `event-registry.ts`, and the tests.
- `src/types/event.ts`, which only declares the event names.
- `src/components/domain/comment/mention-textarea.tsx`, which has a local `emit` function unrelated to the bus.

`event-bus.ts` also exports `emitAndForget`, which is a separate publishing function. I did not count it because the question names one function. I did not check its callers.

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts
